experiment: 15N backbone R1, R2 and 15N-1H NOE with ModelFree analysis (field strength not stated in the main text)
construct_or_mutation: NRC (consensus ankyrin repeat protein: N-cap, one internal consensus repeat, C-cap)
other_conditions: 2 mM NRC; regime (authors): ps-ns timescale motions; related structures: 2L6B (NMR structure of NRC from this paper)
timescale: ps-ns internal motions (ModelFree, per-residue local models selected by chi2 F-test)
author_claim: Backbone amides are uniformly rigid on the ps-ns timescale (high S2) from the first helix of the N-cap through the last helix of the C-cap, including the two recognition loops; the terminal regions have significantly lower S2.
anchor: We find uniformly low dynamic motion (high order parameter, S 2 ) extending from the start of the first helix of the N-cap through the last helix of the C-cap
locator: Results, Backbone dynamics paragraph (Figure 4); conditions: Methods, NMR spectroscopy; temperature from Figure 2A legend
caveat_note: Temperature 25°C is printed in the Figure 2A legend (HSQC at 800 MHz); relaxation field strengths, per-residue S2 and ModelFree tables are in the Supplement (Table S1), which could not be retrieved. Deposit card gives 298 K, 600 MHz and 10% D2O versus 5% D2O here. Only ps-ns motions were probed; no us-ms experiment was done, so slower exchange is not excluded. Sodium phosphate buffer.
